decision: The upstream change modifies an MDC selected-option token selector. Owned legacy option markup and historical M2 option/select styles use distinct mat-option, mat-active and palette selectors; the specific MDC cascade has no target in these owned files. Historical legacy styling is retained and no computed-style execution or broad accessibility conclusion is asserted.
